description: List the models this gateway can route to, best first. Every one is reachable with the same Qumge key — no per-vendor signup. Only tool-calling models are listed: an agent cannot use the others.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 20, max 60.

query.description: Optional. Filter by name or vendor, e.g. 'claude', 'gemini'.

name: list_models
